failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 2 query: 'Leafcutter John Polar Bear electronics Same as You album British jazz' (keyword soup covering already-answered questions). Hop 3 query: 'What role does Leafcutter John play in Polar Bear, and what albums has the band released?' asks questions already fully answered in hop 1 and 2 summaries. Both summaries state the claim is 'accurate and well-supported' yet subsequent queries re-ask the same information rather than advancing.

failure_modes.name: Solver_Irrelevant_Passage_Overprocessing
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 3 retrieved passages include children's book author Bill Martin Jr., The Smiths' 'What Difference Does It Make?', Chicago's 'Does Anybody Really Know What Time It Is?', Damage boy band, and multiple other irrelevant 'What/Does' titled works. The claim was already verified in hops 1-2, yet the system retrieves and presents 10 documents (7 of which are completely irrelevant to Polar Bear or Leafcutter John) without any indication these should be filtered or ignored.

failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 3 query: 'What role does Leafcutter John play in Polar Bear, and what albums has the band released?' is formulated as a natural-language question with compound multi-part structure (two separate information requests bundled together), rather than entity-focused retrieval terms.
